name: print-social-lilac-and-white-blob-review-card-with-black-offset-shadow
title: Lilac Review Card with Offset Shadow
whatItIs: A portrait testimonial on a white and lilac blob background with a small dark logo, a cream label 'Reviews' tilted like tape with purple corner squares, and a lilac card with a hard black offset shadow holding five stars, a review about international transfers and a purple initial avatar with the reviewer's name, with two cream sparkles at the corner.
whatItMeans: The hard offset shadow and tape label give a sticker-like, playful feel to a review, and lilac stays friendly.
techniques: Hard offset black shadow behind the card
Tilted tape-style label with corner squares
Organic lilac blobs as a background
Five white stars and an initial avatar

vocabulary.definition: A solid shadow shifted from a shape without blur.
A label styled like a strip of tape stuck on.
A round badge showing the first letter of a name.
